title: Frankfurt hub capacity crunch
summary: Freighter capacity out of FRA collapsed for three weeks during a peak season crunch. Six nacelle and chemical shipments were stuck at the gateway.
outcome: All six shipments landed within 2 days of plan; no induction moved.
lesson: Pre-agree an AMS gateway fallback rate with the forwarder so the reroute is a one-click booking.

title: Johor machine shop administration
summary: A Tier 2 machine shop in Johor entered administration with 22 open lines of brackets and housings.
outcome: Lines resourced to Bengaluru within 6 weeks; two inductions absorbed the slip in float.
lesson: Machined brackets requalify in 6 weeks; start the first-article inspection the day the credit alert lands.

title: Sole-source forging shop insolvency
summary: A sole-source ring forging supplier went into liquidation with three open POs. The approved but dormant second source was reactivated and broker stock covered the first induction.
options_considered: Reactivate dormant second source with air expedite
option_taken: Reactivate dormant second source with air expedite, broker stock for the first induction
outcome: First induction held; second moved 4 days inside float. No LDs paid.
lesson: Split the first wave 70/30 between the second source and broker stock; the second source cannot ramp to 100% inside four weeks.

title: Paid receiver for in-process WIP
summary: A receiver held finished and in-process forgings until outstanding invoices were settled.
outcome: Parts released after 18 days, of which 11 went to conformity re-inspection. Two lots failed paperwork review.
lesson: WIP from a receiver needs full airworthiness traceability review; budget 10 days and expect partial loss.

title: Nickel alloy allocation
summary: A US mill cut nickel superalloy allocation by 35% for Q3. Casting houses re-sequenced orders by contractual priority.
option_taken: Split 60/40 to Takamori Precision Castings with a price premium
outcome: Engine inductions held; premium of 8% on the split share. Brightwater restored volume in Q4.
lesson: Lock second-source casting slots in the same week the allocation notice lands; slots sell out within 10 days.

title: Typhoon closes north Taiwan fastener plants
summary: A typhoon closed two fastener plants for 8 days. Airframe checks needed pins and collars within a week.
options_considered: Pull forward from US distributor stock
option_taken: Pull forward from US distributor stock
outcome: Two heavy checks held their slots; premium of 35% on 6,000 fasteners.
lesson: Keep a standing price agreement with the US fastener source for emergency volume.

title: Tariff on EU aerostructures
summary: A tariff change on EU aerostructures routed via US facilities raised landed cost on panels.
options_considered: Pull forward shipments before effective date
option_taken: Pull forward shipments before effective date and route direct EU to SIN
outcome: Duty avoided on 80% of affected volume; the rest moved to direct routing.
lesson: Check routing first: most exposure came from US bonded transit, not origin.

title: Licence delay on dual-use sensors
summary: Export licence processing for a sensor family stretched to five weeks.
outcome: Distributor stock covered two engines; licences arrived in week five.
lesson: File licences per quarter in bulk rather than per consignment.

title: Seal batch rejected at receiving
summary: A batch of O-ring seals failed durometer checks at receiving, short-shipping an engine kit.
option_taken: Reallocate from later work order and backfill from US source
outcome: Induction held. Later work order backfilled two weeks before need.
lesson: Reallocation is the fastest lever when a later work order holds released stock of the same batch family.

title: Port Klang congestion
summary: Berth waiting times at Port Klang reached 10 days for feeder sailings.
outcome: Consumables landed in 2 days by road.
lesson: Road via the causeway beats feeder sailings whenever berth waits pass 4 days.

title: Harness plant closure
summary: A health closure order shut a harness plant for four weeks.
option_taken: Distributor buy for the first two engines, repair for the rest
outcome: Engines redelivered on time; repair yield 70%.
lesson: Repair and reuse is viable for ignition leads within the CMM limits; ask the shop early.

title: Early payment for discount with a strategic repair vendor
summary: A strategic nacelle repair vendor under cash pressure threatened to hold shipments over disputed invoices.
options_considered: Pay undisputed items early for discount
option_taken: Pay undisputed items early for a 2% discount and settle disputes within 30 days
outcome: Shipments continued; discount offset part of the dispute concessions.
lesson: Separate undisputed from disputed items; paying the clean ones fast buys goodwill at a profit.
